question.text: What is the minimum net worth requirement for a Category I Merchant Banker under SEBI regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Regulation 7, a Category I merchant banker must maintain a minimum net worth of Rs. 50 crore. Category I is the category permitted to carry on all permitted merchant banking activities. The Trap: The other figures are not the Category I requirement; choosing them confuses Category I with a different category's threshold. Note: The 50 crore figure is the Regulation 7 net worth threshold tied specifically to the Category I distinction.
